# heic-to 1.6.7

Unmodified IIFE distribution from the pinned npm package `heic-to@1.6.7`,
`dist/iife/heic-to.js`. Loaded only when a HEIC photo cannot be decoded natively.
Conversion occurs locally in the browser; no photo is sent to a conversion service.

- Source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later, reproduced in `heic-to-LICENSE.txt`.
- SHA-256 of `heic-to-1.6.7.js`: `99e4d1226915db5ac870b370bbd086a347f1f011d022d48fcf6bc345c72634b3`.

This is an independent, replaceable script; it exposes `window.HeicTo`.
No changes were made to the decoder. Its upstream dependency is libheif;
see the source repository for its build and dependency notices.
